title: Financial Data Scraping and AI Classification Pipeline
summary: Automates the browser, gets past Cloudflare protection, cleans and classifies financial content with an LLM, and stores structured results in MongoDB.
headline: Financial data, collected and classified for you
solution: Playwright drives the browser while preserving user sessions and getting past Cloudflare protections with open-source tools. HTML is parsed and cleaned with BeautifulSoup, spaCy handles text processing and extraction, and Mistral LLM APIs classify the data, with live monitoring for new inputs. Results are structured as JSON, stored in MongoDB, and files are managed through Cloudflare R2.
highlights: Browser automation that keeps user sessions
Cloudflare protection handled with open-source tooling
MongoDB storage and Cloudflare R2 file storage
